texts.Feature:AddressLookup.Description: Fills the city, the street and the coordinates of an address from its postal code and house number through an external address source (PDOK for the Netherlands, OpenStreetMap elsewhere).
texts.OpenTms.Integrations:RoutingUnavailable: The routing service is unavailable; the calculation is retried automatically.
texts.HealthCheck:pdfgeneratorapi:Impact: No document can be generated or printed: CMR, invoices, reports and every other document template.
texts.HealthCheck:pdfgeneratorapi:NotConfigure: The key and secret of the pdfgeneratorapi account are missing. Enter them in Administration → Services → Documents (or set Integrations:PdfGeneratorApi:Key and Secret in the deployment).
texts.HealthCheck:pdfgeneratorapi:Unreachable: pdfgeneratorapi ({target}) cannot be reached. Check the network and pdfgeneratorapi's status page.
texts.HealthCheck:pdfgeneratorapi:Failing: pdfgeneratorapi refuses the request: usually a wrong key or secret, or a missing workspace. Check them in Administration → Services → Documents; the error names the cause.
texts.HealthCheck:routing:Impact: No road distances or driving times: whatever needs them falls back to straight-line estimates (CO₂: the great-circle estimate).
texts.HealthCheck:routing:NotConfigured: The routing provider {provider} has no address. Enter it in Administration → Services → Routing (or set Integrations:Routing in the deployment).
texts.HealthCheck:routing:Unreachable: {provider} ({target}) does not answer. Check that the routing server runs and that the API can reach it; the address is in Administration → Services → Routing.
texts.HealthCheck:route-function:Impact: CO₂ per leg uses the great-circle estimate instead of the road route.
texts.HealthCheck:route-function:NotConfigured: Not configured: CO₂ uses the great-circle estimate. Enter the route function's address in Administration → Services → Routing to use road routes.
texts.HealthCheck:route-function:Unreachable: The route function ({target}) does not answer; CO₂ uses the great-circle estimate meanwhile.
texts.HealthCheck:route-optimizer:Impact: Suggested stop orders come from the built-in heuristic instead of VROOM.
texts.HealthCheck:route-optimizer:NotConfigure: Not configured: the built-in heuristic orders the stops. Enter the VROOM address in Administration → Services → Routing to use VROOM.
texts.HealthCheck:route-optimizer:Unreachable: VROOM ({target}) does not answer; the heuristic orders the stops meanwhile.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:Impact: No e-mail can be sent: invitations, password resets and every other message.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:Ok: Postmark answers for the configured server.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:NotConfigured: The server token or the sender is missing. Enter them in Administration → Services → E-mail, or set Integrations:Postmark:ServerToken and FromAddress.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:Unreachable: Postmark cannot be reached. Check the network and Postmark's status page.
texts.HealthCheck:postmark:Failing: Postmark refuses the server token (HTTP {status}). Check the token in Administration → Services → E-mail.
texts.Services:Notice: Applies to every tenant. A save applies at once on this instance and within a minute on the others. An empty field uses the deployment's configuration, shown under the field.
texts.Services:Section.Documents.Description: Generates every document from its template: CMR, invoices, reports. One account for every tenant.
texts.Services:Section.Routing.Description: Road distances, driving times and routes; the route function also calculates CO₂, VROOM suggests the stop order.
texts.Services:Secret.Stored: A value is stored; leave empty to keep it.
texts.Services:Secret.FromConfiguration: Nothing stored: the deployment's value applies.
texts.Services:Secret.None: Nothing stored, and the deployment has no value.
texts.Services:Url.Invalid: Enter a full address, starting with http:// or https://.
texts.Services:TestUnsaved: Save first: the test uses the saved settings.
texts.Services:InvalidRoutingProvider: Choose OSRM or Route function as the routing provider.
